premise: My brother-in-law sweet-talked me into adding him to my $190,000 home’s deed so he could ‘manage repairs,’ then he sold the house out from under me and vanished; I hired a private investigator who found him living in a beachside condo, proved the deed fraud, reclaimed my house, and now he mows lawns for my ‘Deed of Disgrace Lawn Care’ service, wearing a vest that says ‘Mowed Down My Trust’ while every invoice prints his fraud case number.
